_comment: Specialists (Milestone 6): every player picks one per side in the buy menu [Specialist tab];
each carries one unique gadget (key X). Bots take the ones nobody picked; a fifth player is a Recruit.
Common kit: attackers get drones (key 6) and can buy wall charges (key C); defenders reinforce
walls (hold F) and watch the map cameras (key 6). Gadget numbers live under 'gadgets'.

attack.name: Kiln
attack.desc: Thermal lance: burns a door-sized opening through any destructible wall or hatch - reinforced ones too.

attack.name: Vesper
attack.desc: Pulse scanner: reveals every enemy within 15 m, through walls, to the whole team.

attack.name: Maul
attack.desc: Breaching hammer: smashes holes in soft walls and hatches, wrecks shields and wire.

attack.name: Static
attack.desc: EMP grenades: disable cameras, sensors, jammers and enemy drones in a 7 m radius.

defend.name: Bramble
defend.desc: Razor wire: anyone walking through is slowed to a crawl and rattles loudly.

defend.name: Lantern
defend.desc: Motion sensors: wall-mounted, ping running enemies in front of them to the team.

defend.name: Bulwark
defend.desc: Deployable shield: bullet-proof cover anywhere; only explosives and hammers remove it.

defend.name: Ember
defend.desc: Signal jammer: within 5 m wall charges and lances will not fire and drones lose signal.

recruit.name: Recruit
recruit.desc: No gadget - an extra wall charge (attack) or reinforcement (defence).
